ai_summary: Affordable Robotic & Automation Limited has secured a significant domestic purchase order worth approximately ₹11.06 crore for a robotic welding line, with material delivery expected by March 2027. This order represents a positive material impact on the company's revenue pipeline and financial outlook, fitting within its ordinary course of business. No red flags are apparent, as the transaction is not a related party deal, though the customer's name remains confidential.
